meta.title: Replace motion library with Tailwind transitions in EditPanel
meta.body_summary: Replace motion library usage with Tailwind transitions in four EditPanel StyleTab components, claiming improved performance by removing runtime animation dependency.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced motion library with Tailwind transitions in 4 EditPanel components; no review or maintainer interaction; closed without merge after ~3.8 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 53 changed lines across 4 files, this is a very small, minimal refactoring. As a frontend dependency replacement performance PR, it was closed without merge due to lack of maintainer engagement, not because of size.

core_change_summary.description: In four EditPanel StyleTab components (BorderInput, DisplayInput, NestedInputs, TagDetails), replaced motion.div elements with plain div elements and added Tailwind transition classes instead of motion animation props. The motion library import was removed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are UI markup refactoring; no logic or state changes.
